title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: automatic PTE unpublishing after update.
summary: Starting with SaaS environments, Business Central now automatically unpublishes older versions of private extensions (PTEs) after a new version is installed, keeping only the immediately preceding version to simplify tenant management and prevent clutter.
key_points: Old PTE versions are now automatically unpublished in SaaS when a new version is installed
The version immediately before the current installed version is retained for safety
This prevents accumulation of obsolete extension versions in tenants
Applies to SaaS environments, simplifying extension lifecycle management

quotes.text: Microsoft will automatically unpublish every uninstalled version of the PTE except the version immediately preceding the current installed version.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the safety mechanism that preserves one previous version for potential rollback needs
